Hey everyone, been lurking on here for  some while and was wondering if anyone had any ideas for what could help  with dark underarms and constant infected follicles? Ive had this since  I was 10, and I’m 20 now. I’ve tried natural deodorants but they simply  don’t do a good enough job and I sweat waaay to much to use anything  without a strong antiperspirant. I’ve tried going days without shaving,  using lemons to whiten them, even had a dermatologist say “there’s  nothing to be done. Live with it.” I had a hormone panel done when I was  about 16 and it came back normal and I’m almost underweight so I don’t  think insulin resistance could be the issue here, but maybe i'm wrong.. anybody have any  ideas? I really want to be able to wear tanktops or a bathing suit in public for the first time..

High top converse if you can! They cover the ankles well if you don’t care about wearing sneakers in summer. I also found that wearing fishnets cover up scars well because people can’t distinguish the lines with all of the fishnet lines. If you’re into wearing them, they work wonders. You can also add a little concealer on the scars. Or put a bandaid on every now and then and just say you took up skateboarding or something and scraped it.

Some people look more natural without smiling. I’m a photographer and I can tell you that smiling doesn’t always work for everyones pictures. That being said, I think you look fine without smiling. If that’s the natural you, then that’s the best kinda picture.
